headline: Week 2 keeps winners running while testing answers for Test 1 readout and bundle pressure [ev-d14-test_1-readout][ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3]

content.summary: Week 2 keeps winners running while testing answers for Test 1 readout and bundle pressure [ev-d14-test_1-readout][ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3]

tests.name: w2-t1 Harness Gentle Control Comfort
tests.hypothesis: If we lead with padded gentle control for daily walks, purchase cost stays under target because harness demand is proven [ev-w2-ad_1-week][ev-w2-ad_5-week] and Test 1 is efficient at 0.713x target with only 23 results [ev-d14-test_1-readout]
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per purchase > 16.0 after 2.0x daily spend or after 7 days with no purchases; continue if under target

brief.hook: Tug less, stroll more in a padded fit
brief.key_message: Front clip helps guide gently with a secure comfortable fit for daily walks in the real dog harness, shown unaltered.

tests.name: w2-t2 Fountain Clean Home Upgrade
tests.hypothesis: If we show non porous easy to clean ceramic that looks nice at home, fountain purchases improve because bundle pressure signaled creative fatigue at 24.60 per purchase [ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3] while Test 1 stayed efficient at 11.41 on 23 results [ev-d14-test_1-readout]
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per purchase > 16.0 after 2.0x daily spend; keep if under target and delivering purchases

brief.hook: Fresh flow your cat will love, easy rinse for you
brief.key_message: Ceramic cat water fountain with non porous surface that resists stains and is easy to rinse, shown as the real product in a home setting.

tests.name: w2-t3 Retarget Harness Bundle Nudge
tests.hypothesis: If retargeting highlights harness value plus free shipping over 50 threshold, cart return efficiency holds because cart reminder was 10.25 per purchase [ev-w2-ad_4-week] despite bundle at 24.60 [ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3]
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per purchase > 16.0 after 2.0x daily spend; scale only after sustained under target results

brief.hook: Add the harness to unlock free shipping
brief.key_message: Real dog harness shown unaltered; complete your set to reach free shipping over 50 without altering product features.
